caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur with a leather strap and metal buckle. The spur has a curved, elongated neck with a rowel at the end, which is a circular, spiked wheel featuring eight pointed arms radiating outwards. The color of the metal is primarily a rustic brown, showing areas of wear and oxidation. There is a double-layered, brown leather strap threaded through a square, brass-colored buckle at one end. Attached to the body of the spur by metal loops is a short, linked chain, exhibiting a silvery metallic sheen. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and the objects are centered and rendered in realistic detail on the page. The artist’s signature, "R.W.F. Taylor," appears in small, red text in the lower right corner.
title: Spur
